positions.title: DevOps Developer
positions.description:
• Automated the location’s inventory system using JIRA as the primary source of data storage.
• Developed a script using Groovy which formats inventory data  and sends it to an IBM database using REST API calls. 
• Modified Puppet and Icinga configuration files in order to update monitoring system for Apache servers.
• Received a three-day Agile training course.

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
• Worked with finite state transducer, open kernel, and SVM libraries to generate a classification model.
• Developed Python scripts that uses patient data to create the classification model and measure its precision.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Worked as a Software Developer in a Big Data research internship.
•	Developed a metadata index builder that manages donor sample data at a Big Data scale.
•	Worked with RESTful search and analytics engine, and AWS cloud service.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Intern
positions.description:
•	Developed Image Processing technique to segment tissue regions in Histopathological Images.
•	Effectively communicated with fellow colleagues to develop tissue segmentation algorithm.
•	Exhibit outstanding presentation skills by exhibiting research results in a poster Presentation.

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description: Developed a vocabulary used to program by voice and worked with Open Source speech recognition software to implement the vocabulary.

company.name: University of Puerto Rico, Río Piedras

positions.title: Food and Beverage
positions.description:
•	Effectively communicated with Leaders and fellow Cast Members in order to prepare and serve quality food in a timely manner.
•	Ability to manage multiple tasks by preparing food and serving for guests.
•	Proven adaptability and flexibility qualities by working in multiple work locations including Pinocchio Village Haus and Tomorrowland Terrace Restaurant in Magic Kingdom.
•	Exhibit outstanding leadership qualities by teaching new Cast Members specific tasks. 
•	Successfully completed educational courses including Disney’s Academic Marketing You Career Development Course and Disney’s Academic Corporate Communication Course.
